## Scope
What is implemented? Which phase does this belong to?

## Validation
- [ ] `npm ci --ignore-scripts`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Windows command behavior tested using a controlled fixture or a real Wallpaper Engine installation
- [ ] No undocumented Ulanzi or Wallpaper Engine APIs
- [ ] No secrets, personal file paths, raw wallpaper paths, or settings values in logs
- [ ] RTK / CMR benchmark snapshots recorded if testing with Claude Code
- [ ] No release or Store upload until device validation is complete
